recipe.visualDefinition: A low-key studio portrait of two men in dark streetwear, featuring a central vertical axis defined by a large, metallic gold monogram. The atmosphere is moody and cinematic, characterized by deep shadows, high-contrast lighting, and a wisp of white smoke.
coreVisualRelationships: Symmetrical balance between two subjects flanking a central graphic
High contrast between matte black clothing and reflective gold lettering
Organic smoke texture against rigid geometric and calligraphic type forms
Depth created through overlapping subjects and foreground typography
coreInvariants: Polished gold material for the central logo
Low-angle or eye-level perspective with aggressive posing
Hard-edged rim lighting to define silhouettes against the dark background

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two male figures occupy the left and right thirds of the frame, scaled to waist-up portraits.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: A large, vertically stacked gold monogram positioned exactly in the center of the composition.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the bright gold center, moves upward to the faces of the subjects, and follows the smoke trail toward the top right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy use of dark, vignetted negative space at the edges to focus attention on the subjects and logo.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep charcoal and black (wardrobe and background)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extremely low saturation across the image, with high value contrast in the metallic reflections and highlights.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to black, grey, white, and gold

characterSpecificRedesigns: Top character features an elongated, curved descender that acts as a divider
Bottom character uses a hexagonal, geometric frame

treatment.shadow: Soft drop shadow to separate from background

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single dominant custom mark with minimal, utilitarian sans-serif metadata in the corners.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the aggressive, urban tone of the custom mark
Captures the metallic, carved look of the logo

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a low-key studio portrait of two men in black leather jackets and sunglasses against a dark grey background. One man on the right should be exhaling a thick wisp of white smoke. Use high-contrast rim lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, vertically stacked 3D gold monogram in a Gothic style to the center. Ensure the gold has realistic reflections and a slight bevel.

verificationChecks: Is the gold material reflective and high-contrast?
Is the background sufficiently dark to make the rim light pop?
Is the smoke texture realistic and not obscuring the faces?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subjects
Any existing brand logos on the clothing
postGenerationChecks: Check for 3D depth in the central logo
Ensure the smoke has a natural, wispy flow
Verify the lighting consistency between subjects and logo
Confirm the color palette is strictly noir with gold accents
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban Noir + Gothic Gold Centerpiece + Symmetrical Duo Portrait
